parole.significato: A plant formerly used to provide alkaline ashes for soap-making, Salsola aphylla.
A shrub or tree, Euclea divinorum; its fruit can be fermented to produce vinegar.
parole.testo: From Khwe gwarri (which also derived Zulu umgwali).
